decisions.reason: Uses LinkType Junction, Target, and link: patch marker to establish one physical directory reached by two paths; repo edit is the deploy, copying is a self-copy; contrast table for copied installs.

Host process owns both the file-handle locks (browser tab holds none, locks are process-scoped) and the boot-time client-bundle cache; browser HTTP cache is a separate second layer needing cache-bypassing refresh after host restart; no extrapolation beyond documented behavior.

Explains junction rename moved the sole files and made the source copy fail (source path renamed away); recovery: stop host, rename .old2 back preserving content, node --check both files, feature-marker grep, then activate; no deletes or recreation.

Ordered procedure: edit → static check → fully stop host → restart dsh web → hard refresh (order matters) → verify served bytes, registration, boot log, and behavior; syntax check not treated as activation.

Two-command pre-flight (LinkType/Target + link: marker in cordis.patch.yml, plus package.json corroboration) choosing linked vs copied procedure; detailed explanation of why generic copy advice caused the outage.

caps.reason: Plan explicitly prohibits copying, reinstalling, or deleting .old2 files; paths treated as one directory.
Plan mandates full host stop and restart; browser-only refresh explicitly called insufficient.
